text_block_list.text:
"Offer your prayers to the statue of the
Three
Goddesses!"
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Who am I to refuse such a
command from
the great Shiraoki?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Praying here will bring me great
blessings, no
doubt about it!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
